name: Numbing Wind, Greater
body:
School evocation [air, cold]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 8, storm knight 8

Components: V, S, M (a very small crystal or glass cone)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 60 ft.

Effect: Line-shaped cold wind emanating out from you to the extreme of the range.

Duration: Instantaneous (see text)

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

As lesser numbing wind, but the maximum nonlethal damage is 12d4. Dexterity loss is 1d6+1 additional point per two caster levels (maximum 1d6+8).
